generate_graph_from_atomic_structure: generate a graph representation from atomic structure data with periodic boundary conditions and a cutoff distance
filter_edges_by_node_partition: filter graph edges to keep only those where the target atom belongs to the current rank node partition
compute_pbc_distances: compute interatomic distances with periodic boundary condition corrections using cell offsets and edge indices
review_generate_graph: review the generate_graph function to understand how radius graph versions 1, 2, and 3 are selected
refactor_get_pbc_distances: refactor get_pbc_distances to support additional distance metrics beyond Euclidean norm
